name: ondemand-blender-mcp

tools.name: get_scene_info
tools.description: Inspect the active Blender scene. Returns the scene name, the object count and every object with its type, location, rotation and scale. Call this before mutating the scene so you act on real object names.

tools.name: get_object_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about one named object: transform, assigned materials, and mesh statistics (vertex, edge and polygon counts).

name.description: Exact name of the object in the Blender scene, e.g. 'Cube'.

tools.name: get_viewport_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current 3D viewport as a PNG image and return it base64-encoded, so the agent can visually verify the scene.

max_size.description: Longest edge of the returned image in pixels.

tools.name: execute_blender_code
tools.description: Execute arbitrary Python inside the running Blender process with full bpy access. DANGEROUS: unsandboxed — the snippet runs with the privileges of the Blender process and can read or write the filesystem. Disabled unless EXEC_ENABLED=true and the add-on's 'Enable Code Execution' toggle is on. Prefer a first-class tool.

code.description: Python source executed inside Blender with bpy in scope.

tools.name: create_object
tools.description: Create a primitive mesh, empty, camera or light in the active scene at an optional location, rotation and scale. Returns the object name Blender assigned.

name.description: Optional name; Blender auto-names the object when omitted.

rotation.description: Euler rotation in radians [x, y, z].

tools.name: modify_object
tools.description: Modify an existing object: move, rotate, scale, rename or toggle its viewport/render visibility. Only the supplied fields change.

name.description: Exact name of the object to modify.

rotation.description: New Euler rotation in radians [x, y, z].

new_name.description: Rename the object to this value.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Permanently delete a named object from the Blender scene.

name.description: Exact name of the object to delete.

tools.name: set_material
tools.description: Create or reuse a material and assign it to an object, setting the Principled BSDF base colour, metallic and roughness values.

object_name.description: Exact name of the object to shade.

material_name.description: Name of the material to create or reuse.

color.description: Base colour [R, G, B] or [R, G, B, A], each channel 0.0-1.0.

metallic.description: Metallic factor of the Principled BSDF, 0.0-1.0.

roughness.description: Roughness factor of the Principled BSDF, 0.0-1.0.

tools.name: poly_haven_search
tools.description: Search the Poly Haven CC0 asset library for HDRIs, textures or models. Requires POLYHAVEN_ENABLED=true and the add-on's Poly Haven toggle.

asset_type.description: Restrict results to one Poly Haven category.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tools.name: poly_haven_download
tools.description: Download a Poly Haven asset by slug and import it into the scene (HDRIs become the world environment; models and textures are linked in).

tools.name: sketchfab_search
tools.description: Search Sketchfab for downloadable 3D models. Requires a Sketchfab API key configured in the Blender add-on preferences.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

downloadable_only.description: Restrict results to models that can be downloaded.

tools.name: sketchfab_download
tools.description: Download a Sketchfab model by its UID and import it into the Blender scene. Requires a Sketchfab API key in the add-on preferences.

uid.description: Sketchfab model UID from a prior search result.

tools.name: hyper3d_generate_model
tools.description: Generate a 3D model from a text prompt using Hyper3D Rodin and import the result into Blender. Requires a Hyper3D API key in the add-on.

prompt.description: Text description of the model to generate.

image_url.description: Optional reference image URL to condition generation.

tools.name: hunyuan3d_generate_model
tools.description: Generate a 3D model from text or an image using Hunyuan3D and import the result into Blender. Requires a Hunyuan3D API key in the add-on.

prompt.description: Text description of the model to generate.

image_url.description: Optional reference image URL to condition generation.

texture.description: Whether to generate textures alongside the mesh.
